sources.title: dr-housemd/G4-MeroMero-v2-31B-exl3-4bpw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A finetune of Gemma 4 31B designed for creative tasks, particularly narrative RP. Intended to be a more creative version of G4-MeroMero-31B. This model is the result of a lot of experimentation and learning. Trying to make Gemma 4 more creative without destroying the intelligence is... difficult. To put it mildly.
